svg.data-weight: 16 kg with PSUs and fans (datasheet); QSG says 14.5 kg
svg.data-input-dc: -40 to -75 VDC, 40 A max per PSU
svg.data-software: ONIE preinstalled; ONL and commercial NOS supported

g.data-description: QSG Front LEDs callout 1 - LED1 (top) - Cyan (400G), Blue (100G). All eight QSFP-DD ports carry it, including the four wired at 100G
g.title: led-port-0-a

g.data-description: QSG Front LEDs callouts 1 and 2 - LED2 - Blue (all lanes linked), Red (not all lanes linked), Blinking (activity). Blinking is a behaviour rather than a colour - the lamp flashes in whatever colour it is already showing, so `activity` declares the blink and no colour of its own
